metadata.description: 12-page Manga Me post-Chapter 2 commentary SBL generated from the approved commentary script.

production.binding_requirement: Every rendered page must produce exactly two separate registration-identical PNG files: base artwork and transparent RGBA lettering overlay.
production.base_artwork: IAKESI-CH2-POST-PC-###-art.png — complete artwork only; no reader-visible dialogue, captions, balloons, tails, or page numbers.
production.lettering_overlay: IAKESI-CH2-POST-PC-###-lettering.png — transparent RGBA layer containing reader-visible commentary lettering only.
production.registration: Both files use the same 1024×1536 master canvas, crop, orientation, and origin.
production.folio_handling: EXCLUDED. No page numbers in either rendered layer.

production_rules.narrator: Manga Me is the recurring narrator/host and must follow the canonical Manga Me character sheet.
production_rules.style_binding: Full-color realistic manga commentary. Manga Me must remain recognizably consistent with his canonical sheet. Recreated production problems may be exaggerated for humor.
production_rules.production_sheet_binding: Use the Chapter 2 Commentary Production Sheet as the canonical visual reference for speech-balloon examples, layer workflow, regeneration labels, 70/30 style comparisons, style drift, and tool representations.
production_rules.dramatization: Use whiteboards sparingly. Prefer placing Manga Me inside visual recreations of the production problem.
production_rules.reader_visible_text: Only dialogue, captions, and explicitly requested diegetic labels are reader-visible. Script page titles, scene labels, production directions, camera notes, asset names, and page numbers are not printed.
production_rules.print_safety: All faces, dialogue, captions, essential props, and other critical information must remain inside the page-side safe area. Background-only material may extend through trim and bleed.
production_rules.two_file_delivery_binding: Produce exactly two registration-identical PNGs per page: art and lettering. Do not flatten.
production_rules.lettering: Use professional uppercase comic lettering. Preserve wording and punctuation from the script. One tail per speech-bubble chain; captions have no tail.
production_rules.page_numbers: Do not render page numbers or folios anywhere in the post-commentary.
